Subject: Follow-up: POC success criteria & next steps

Sophie — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

- POC objective: validate Redwood inference latency and cost improvements for MedBase’s patient triage pipeline (500–1000 concurrent sessions, 2k avg tokens/session).
- Success criteria (high-level):
  * 95th percentile latency < 300ms per response for the triage flow.
  * End-to-end inference cost per 1k requests reduced by >= 30% vs current infra.
  * No regression in safety/accuracy on the 300-case prompt set (we’ll run evals you provide).
- Proposed timeline: kickoff next Wed (6/24), 2-week technical trial, final readout with execs during week of 7/13.

I attached a draft success-criteria spreadsheet and a starting SOW for internal alignment. Can you confirm: 1) these success criteria look right, 2) who will own the evaluation on your side (name + role), and 3) any blackout dates between 6/24–7/17?

I'll put together a short mutual action plan once you confirm owners.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Thanks Marissa — great summary and aligned on the goals. A few clarifications: 

- Owners: Liam O'Connor (Director, Clinical Ops) will own the evaluation and Evan Rogers (Lead ML Eng) will be the technical contact for the trial.
- Timeline: 6/24 kickoff works, 2-week trial is fine but Liam asked if we can extend to 3 weeks if we hit integration blockers. Can we build a 1-week optional extension into the plan?
- Blackouts: None in late June/early July. Leadership is available the week of 7/13 for a readout but they'd prefer Tues/Thu mornings.

We'll fill in the prompt/testset TSV and drop it into the shared Drive folder by EOD Friday.

Appreciate the quick reply, Sophie — that all makes sense. We can include a one-week contingency extension in the plan. Proposed mutual action plan (high-level):

- 6/24 Kickoff call (Redwood + MedBase: product, Eng, Ops) — set SSO, data access, baseline run. Owner: Marissa (Redwood) / Liam (MedBase).
- 6/25–7/02 Integration & baseline collection — Marcus to assist with container/SSO details.
- 7/03–7/09 Evaluation window (2 weeks) — run the test set, collect latency/cost/quality metrics.
- 7/10–7/13 Optional extension / buffer week if needed.
- Week of 7/13 Final readout w/ execs (preferred Tue or Thu AM).

Action items for this week: Marcus — can you confirm the SSO flow and any infra pre-reqs? Rachel — can you prepare a short readout template we can share with MedBase ahead of the exec meeting? Sophie — once we have your testset in Drive, Marcus will queue a baseline run and share a short troubleshooting checklist.

I'll convert this to a brief mutual action plan doc and share a DocuSign SOW draft if we need a formal sign for reserved capacity during the trial.

Thanks,
Marissa

Hi all — quick technical note and checklist for the kickoff: 

- SSO / Access: MedBase needs an Okta service account with API access. Sophie, can Liam provision that (client id + cert) and drop in Drive?
- Data: we'll need the prompt/testset TSV and one redacted sample payload for schema validation. Please keep PHI out of the sample; use synthetic/placeholder values.
- Environment: We'll spin up a dedicated trial instance under your account. Expected infra time: ~2 hours to provision, then 4–6 hours for the first baseline run depending on queue.
- Metrics: I'll export a short dashboard (latency percentiles, per-request token cost, accuracy against test labels) and share the link within 24 hours of the baseline run.

If everything above is ready by EOD Tue 6/23 I can schedule the provisioning for Wed morning (6/24).

— Marcus Lin
